{
  "id": "PUB009",
  "title": "Calculate Moving Average",
  "difficulty": "medium",
  "requirements": "# Calculate Moving Average\n\n- **Difficulty:** Medium (medium)\n\n## Requirements\n\nWrite a function block FB that calculates and updates a moving arithmetic mean. The moving arithmetic mean is a method of averaging over consecutive data points, where each new data point replaces the oldest data point, and then the average is recalculated.\n\n1. When cyclicExecution is TRUE, a new data value is automatically read and the moving average average is updated every scan cycle.\n2. Provide an external trigger signal trigger, which reads a new data value and updates the moving average upon each rising edge.\n3. Provide a reset function reset, which resets the moving average calculation when the reset signal is TRUE. If the window size is less than 1 or greater than 100, output an error status and status code.\n\nThe status parameter indicates the execution status of the program:\n- 16#0000: Execution successful\n- 16#8200: Window length setting error, please set a value between 1 and 100.\n\n## Interface Definition\n\n| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Input | `cyclicExecution` | `BOOL` | When TRUE, periodic reading is performed, and trigger has no effect |\n| Input | `trigger` | `BOOL` | External trigger signal, reads value upon each rising edge |\n| Input | `value` | `LREAL` | Newly read data value |\n| Input | `windowSize` | `INT` | The window size for the moving average, which must be between 1 and 100 |\n| Input | `reset` | `BOOL` | Reset signal, resets the moving average calculation when TRUE |\n| Output | `average` | `LREAL` | The moving average |\n| Output | `windowSizeReached` | `BOOL` | FALSE: Maximum window width not yet reached TRUE: Maximum window width has been reached |\n| Output | `error` | `BOOL` | FALSE: No error occurred TRUE: An error occurred during the execution of FB |\n| Output | `status` | `WORD` | Status code |",
  "scenario": "Write a function block FB that calculates and updates a moving arithmetic mean. The moving arithmetic mean is a method of averaging over consecutive data points, where each new data point replaces the oldest data point, and then the average is recalculated.",

  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Invalid window returns an error before sampling.",
    "Reset overrides sample acceptance.",
    "Cyclic and trigger conditions cannot cause double insertion."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "During warm-up, average is the mean of the actual accepted samples; zero-filled unused capacity is excluded.",
    "reset has priority over sampling for a valid window; it clears history and sets average=0 and windowSizeReached=FALSE.",
    "Changing a valid windowSize clears history before any same-scan accepted sample. Invalid window sets error/status and does not accept or change history.",
    "An invalid-window scan preserves average/windowSizeReached. Returning to a valid window clears error/status. Trigger edge history is updated on every invocation, including reset and invalid-window scans.",
    "cyclicExecution accepts exactly one sample per scan and ignores the trigger. windowSizeReached becomes TRUE once the accepted sample count reaches windowSize.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "Floating-point inputs and intermediate reference arithmetic are finite. Existing fixed traces retain their declared absolute tolerance; claims do not extend to arbitrary magnitudes without a separately specified numeric error policy.",
    "LREAL average comparisons allow up to abs<=1e-5 (and matching relative precision on T2). P6 initializes previousTrigger=FALSE prior to scan k=0.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "PUB009.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"

      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",

      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"

    {
      "id": "PUB009.P4",
      "formula": "G((valid & !reset) -> average=meanOrZero(historyAfter))",

      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB009.P5",
      "formula": "G(valid -> (windowSizeReached <-> length(historyAfter)=windowSize))",
      "explanation": "Full-window indication follows history population.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB009.P6",
      "formula": "G(trigger <-> X(previousTrigger))",
      "explanation": "Both operands are Boolean propositions. previousTrigger[0]=FALSE; previousTrigger[k+1]=I[k].trigger on every invocation, including invalid/reset.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB009.P7",
      "formula": "G((valid & !reset & !cyclicExecution & !triggerRise & !windowChanged) -> unchangedMean)",
      "explanation": "No event means no sample update.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "valid": "1<=windowSize<=100",
    "triggerRise": "trigger & !previousTrigger",
    "accept": "valid & !reset & (cyclicExecution | triggerRise)",
    "history": "Ghost ordered list of at most windowSize accepted samples, newest last.",
    "historyAfter": "history after clearing on reset/window change and adding one accepted sample, discarding oldest if full.",
    "unchangedMean": "average and windowSizeReached equal their pre-scan values.",
    "interface names": "Identically named sampled input or observed output.",
    "meanOrZero": "Arithmetic mean for a nonempty list, otherwise zero.",
    "length": "Number of samples in the history list.",
    "windowChanged": "Current valid windowSize differs from the last valid configured size.",
    "previousTrigger": "{\"kind\": \"previous_sampled_input\", \"source\": \"I[k-1].trigger\", \"initial\": false, \"update\": \"After EVERY scan k, including invalid/reset/stop, store I[k].trigger\"}",
    "cyclicExecution": "I[k].cyclicExecution: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "trigger": "I[k].trigger: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "value": "I[k].value: sampled input (LREAL).",
    "windowSize": "I[k].windowSize: sampled input (INT).",

    "windowSizeReached": "O[k].windowSizeReached: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "error": "O[k].error: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "status": "O[k].status: independently observed post-scan candidate value (WORD); never defined as expected output.",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.average=0.0, O_init.windowSizeReached=false, O_init.error=false, O_init.status=0."
  }

ARCHITECTURAL PLAN:
{
  "state_machine": {
    "states": [
      {
        "name": "S_INIT",
        "description": "Fresh pre-scan instance. Outputs hold declared initial values."
      },
      {
        "name": "S_INVALID",
        "description": "windowSize < 1 or windowSize > 100. error=TRUE, status=16#8200. No sample accepted. History and internal mean/reached are preserved."
      },
      {
        "name": "S_RESET_CLEAR",
        "description": "Valid window and reset=TRUE. History is cleared, average=0.0, windowSizeReached=FALSE. No sample accepted."
      },
      {
        "name": "S_EMPTY",
        "description": "Valid window, no error, historyCount=0."
      },
      {
        "name": "S_WARMUP",
        "description": "Valid window, no error, 0 < historyCount < windowSize."
      },
      {
        "name": "S_FULL",
        "description": "Valid window, no error, historyCount=windowSize. windowSizeReached=TRUE."
      }
    ],
    "transitions": [
      {
        "from": "S_INIT",
        "to": "S_INVALID",
        "guard": "windowSize < 1 OR windowSize > 100",
        "action": "Set invalid/error state. Preserve internalAverage, internalWindowSizeReached, and history. Do not accept sample."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_INIT",
        "to": "S_RESET_CLEAR",
        "guard": "validWindow AND reset",
        "action": "Clear history and historySum. internalAverage:=0.0; internalWindowSizeReached:=FALSE; lastValidWindowSize:=windowSize. Do not accept sample."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_INIT",
        "to": "[S_EMPTY if count=0; S_WARMUP if 0<count<windowSize; S_FULL if count=windowSize]",
        "guard": "validWindow AND NOT reset",
        "action": "If windowChanged, clear history before any sample. If cyclicExecution OR triggerRise, accept exactly one sample and update ring buffer/sum/count. Set state from historyCount."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_INVALID",
        "to": "S_INVALID",
        "guard": "windowSize < 1 OR windowSize > 100",
        "action": "Keep error/status set. Preserve internalAverage, internalWindowSizeReached, and history. Do not accept sample."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_INVALID",
        "to": "S_RESET_CLEAR",
        "guard": "validWindow AND reset",
        "action": "Return to valid configuration, clear error/status, clear history, set average=0.0 and reached=FALSE. Update lastValidWindowSize."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_INVALID",
        "to": "[S_EMPTY if count=0 after optional clear; S_WARMUP if 0<count<windowSize; S_FULL if count=windowSize]",
        "guard": "validWindow AND NOT reset",
        "action": "Clear error/status. If windowChanged, clear history before same-scan sample. Accept at most one sample if cyclicExecution OR triggerRise."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_RESET_CLEAR",
        "to": "S_INVALID",
        "guard": "windowSize < 1 OR windowSize > 100",
        "action": "Invalid window takes priority. Set error/status and preserve current mean/history."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_RESET_CLEAR",
        "to": "S_RESET_CLEAR",
        "guard": "validWindow AND reset",
        "action": "Continue clearing history and forcing average=0.0, reached=FALSE. No sample accepted."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_RESET_CLEAR",
        "to": "[S_EMPTY if no accept; S_WARMUP or S_FULL if accept]",
        "guard": "validWindow AND NOT reset",
        "action": "If cyclicExecution OR triggerRise, accept one sample; otherwise remain empty. State selected by resulting historyCount."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_EMPTY",
        "to": "S_INVALID",
        "guard": "windowSize < 1 OR windowSize > 100",
        "action": "Set error/status. Preserve mean/history."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_EMPTY",
        "to": "S_RESET_CLEAR",
        "guard": "validWindow AND reset",
        "action": "Clear history and force average=0.0, reached=FALSE."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_EMPTY",
        "to": "S_EMPTY / S_WARMUP / S_FULL",
        "guard": "validWindow AND NOT reset",
        "action": "If windowChanged, clear history. Accept one sample only if cyclicExecution OR triggerRise. Next state by count."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_WARMUP",
        "to": "S_INVALID",
        "guard": "windowSize < 1 OR windowSize > 100",
        "action": "Set error/status. Preserve internal mean/history."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_WARMUP",
        "to": "S_RESET_CLEAR",
        "guard": "validWindow AND reset",
        "action": "Clear history and force average=0.0, reached=FALSE."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_WARMUP",
        "to": "S_WARMUP / S_FULL / S_EMPTY",
        "guard": "validWindow AND NOT reset",
        "action": "If windowChanged, clear history first. If cyclicExecution OR triggerRise, accept one sample. Next state by count; no event holds WARMUP."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_FULL",
        "to": "S_INVALID",
        "guard": "windowSize < 1 OR windowSize > 100",
        "action": "Set error/status. Preserve internal mean/history/reached."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_FULL",
        "to": "S_RESET_CLEAR",
        "guard": "validWindow AND reset",
        "action": "Clear history and force average=0.0, reached=FALSE."
      },
      {
        "from": "S_FULL",
        "to": "S_FULL / S_WARMUP / S_EMPTY",
        "guard": "validWindow AND NOT reset",
        "action": "If windowChanged, clear history first. If cyclicExecution OR triggerRise, replace oldest and keep count=windowSize. No event holds FULL."
      }
    ]
  },
  "timer_plan": {

  },
  "priorities": [

    "Invalid-window scans preserve average, windowSizeReached, and active history; only error/status are forced.",
    "For a valid window, reset overrides sample acceptance: clear history, average=0.0, windowSizeReached=FALSE, and accept no sample in that scan.",
    "For a valid window, returning from invalid clears error/status.",
    "A valid window-size change clears history before any same-scan accepted sample.",
    "Accept exactly one sample per scan when validWindow AND NOT reset AND (cyclicExecution OR triggerRise).",
    "cyclicExecution and triggerRise are ORed; they must never cause double insertion.",
    "triggerRise is computed from pre-scan previousTrigger; previousTrigger is updated unconditionally on every scan, including invalid, reset, hold, and no-event scans.",
    "Ring-buffer access is bounded to 0..99; windowSize is validated before any indexing based on it.",
    "Outputs are assigned once in the final unified output stage from internal state, not from multiple code paths."

  "initial_values": {

    "windowSizeReached": false,
    "error": false,
    "status": 0,
    "status_comment": "16#0000",

    "lastValidWindowSize": 0,
    "historyBuffer": "ARRAY[0..99] OF LREAL initialized to 0.0",
    "historyCount": 0,
    "historyHead": 0,
    "historySum": 0.0,
    "internalAverage": 0.0,
    "internalWindowSizeReached": false,
    "invalidWindow": false,
    "triggerRise": false,
    "windowChanged": false,
    "state": "S_INIT"
  },
  "scan_execution_order": [
    "Stage 1 - Edge sampling: sample all inputs once. triggerRise := trigger AND NOT previousTrigger using the retained pre-scan previousTrigger. Then update previousTrigger := trigger unconditionally for this scan, including invalid/reset/no-event scans.",
    "Stage 2 - Safety/reset priority and state transitions: evaluate window validity first. Invalid: set invalid flag/error/status and preserve history/internal mean/windowSizeReached; accept no sample. Valid: clear error/status; if reset, clear history and force internal average=0.0 and reached=FALSE; else if valid window size changed, clear history before same-scan sampling; then accept exactly one sample only if cyclicExecution OR triggerRise. Update ring buffer, historySum, historyCount, internalAverage, and internalWindowSizeReached. Select next state.",
    "Stage 3 - Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF: no timer FBs are used in this FB. If a timer is added later, call it unconditionally at top level before final output assignment, never inside CASE/IF or state transition branches.",
    "Stage 4 - Unified output assignments: average := internalAverage; windowSizeReached := internalWindowSizeReached; error := invalidWindow; status := IF invalidWindow THEN 16#8200 ELSE 16#0000. No output is written outside this stage."
  ],
  "formal_assertions": [
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "formula": "G(((windowSize < 1) | (windowSize > 100)) -> (error & (status = 16#8200)))"
    },
    {
      "id": "A2",
      "formula": "G((((windowSize >= 1) & (windowSize <= 100))) -> (!error & (status = 16#0000)))"
    },
    {
      "id": "A3",
      "formula": "G((((windowSize >= 1) & (windowSize <= 100)) & reset) -> ((average = 0.0) & !windowSizeReached))"
    },
    {
      "id": "A4",
      "formula": "G((status = 16#8200) <-> ((windowSize < 1) | (windowSize > 100)))"
    },
    {
      "id": "A5",
      "formula": "G((status = 16#0000) <-> (((windowSize >= 1) & (windowSize <= 100))))"
    }
  ]
}

  }
